# Set up by hand (botport)

What botport could not set up from the Grok bot's description. Names only: no secret value is copied.

- [ ] connector Web search: builtin connector: enable the matching Hermes tool or MCP server by hand
- [ ] credential VISITOR_LOG_TOKEN: set it on the Hermes side by hand (e.g. the profile's .env); no value was copied
- [x] schedule On new visitor: event-triggered on the Grok side: Hermes cron cannot subscribe to it; set up a trigger by hand
